candidates.change_summary: Change assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp).
Set acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp unconditionally (ignore input _unlockTime).
Remove update to acc.unlockTime entirely so it is not modified by Put.
Invert the comparison so acc.unlockTime is set to block.timestamp when _unlockTime>block.timestamp, else to _unlockTime (flips which value chosen).
After increasing acc.balance, subtract msg.value (net no-op to balance) so balance does not change overall but unlockTime still updated.
Replace the strict '>' unlockTime check with '>=' so collection is allowed when block.timestamp equals unlockTime.
Remove the MinSum requirement so users can collect amounts even when acc.balance < MinSum.
Change subtraction order to compute acc.balance = _am - acc.balance which will underflow/behave differently and alter final acc.balance (in solidity ^0.8 it will revert on invalid cases).
Move the external call to before updating acc.balance so funds are sent prior to state change.
Change the call method to transfer remaining gas using 'send' instead of 'call', which returns false on failure rather than bubbling revert and limits gas, changing observable behavior on collect.
